ai.intro: Editor's note for the AI issue.

picks.title: A lab ships a smaller model that runs on a laptop
picks.summary: The release trades a little accuracy for a model that fits in 8 GB of memory, which puts offline assistants within reach of ordinary machines.

picks.title: Un nouveau modèle ouvert pour le français
picks.summary: Un consortium publie un modèle entraîné surtout sur des textes en français, sous licence ouverte.

picks.title: Coding assistant adds a review mode
picks.summary: The assistant now reads a whole pull request and leaves comments, instead of only completing lines.

picks_en.title: A lab ships a smaller model that runs on a laptop
picks_en.summary: The release trades a little accuracy for a model that fits in 8 GB of memory, which puts offline assistants within reach of ordinary machines.

picks_en.title: Coding assistant adds a review mode
picks_en.summary: The assistant now reads a whole pull request and leaves comments, instead of only completing lines.

picks_en.title: Speech model handles twelve new languages
picks_en.summary: An update to an open speech recognizer adds twelve languages with little training data.

runners_up.title: Image model gets a cheaper tier
runners_up.summary: A lower-priced plan with slower generation aims at hobbyists.

finance.intro: Editor's note for the finance issue.

picks.title: Stablecoin rules move ahead in two countries
picks.summary: Both proposals would require issuers to hold cash reserves and publish monthly audits, a step toward treating stablecoins like bank deposits.

picks.title: A payments app adds instant transfers abroad
picks.summary: Transfers to twenty countries now settle in seconds, with a flat fee shown before sending.

runners_up.title: Bitcoin ETF flows turn positive again
runners_up.summary: After three weeks of outflows, funds took in new money as prices steadied.

runners_up.title: Neobank reports its first profitable quarter
runners_up.summary: Lower marketing spend and higher interest income did most of the work.

gaming.intro: Editor's note for the games issue.

picks.title: A quiet puzzle game wins over reviewers
picks.summary: Critics praise its hand-drawn levels and a final act that rethinks every rule the game taught you.

picks.title: Long-awaited sequel arrives with a new engine
picks.summary: Reviews call the open world bigger but emptier, with frame-rate trouble on older consoles.

picks.title: Indie racer leaves early access
picks.summary: Version 1.0 adds a career mode and split-screen play.

runners_up.title: Remaster of a 2004 classic gets a release date
runners_up.summary: It lands in February with rebuilt cutscenes.

picks.title: Heavy rocket completes its fifth test flight
picks.summary: Both stages came back intact, and the company says the next flight will carry real satellites.

picks.title: Satellite internet reaches two more countries
picks.summary: Regulators approved service after a year of talks over spectrum.

runners_up.title: Crew capsule mission set for spring
runners_up.summary: Four astronauts will spend six months on the station.

papers.title: Small Models Can Check Their Own Work
papers.summary: A training trick teaches compact models to spot and fix their own mistakes before answering. On math benchmarks the 3B model now matches one ten times its size.
